meta.title: A token with a made-up signature is refused
gaps: act 1: cannot be executed — the buyer's web-console session may not call GET /v1/attachments/open (attachments#open is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml); such a call is answered 401 and signs the session out

The requested unauthenticated GET /v1/attachments/open?token=UUFfUGxhdGZvcm0tLTAwMDA cannot be executed with the available operations: a buyer session is unauthorized for this route and no unauthenticated request actor is supported, so HTTP
